content.value_statement: Teams need reliable notice when Gmail receives new messages. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use gws to watch Gmail, filter labels, and stream results.
actual_capabilities: Starts Gmail watch through the gws gmail +watch command.
Streams new email events as NDJSON for downstream processing.
Uses an existing Pub/Sub topic or subscription when provided.
Filters messages by Gmail label IDs such as INBOX or UNREAD.
Controls batch size, polling interval, message format, and one-shot mode.
Writes each watched message to a chosen output directory.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI, Google authentication, Gmail permissions, and Pub/Sub access.
Gmail watches expire after seven days and must be renewed.
Full and raw message formats can include sensitive email content.
The package contains documentation only, not implementation source code.

prompt_templates.prompt: Use gws-gmail-watch to start watching my Gmail inbox with project my-gcp-project.

prompt_templates.title: Watch Inbox Once
prompt_templates.prompt: Watch Gmail for INBOX messages once, then summarize what the command will output.

prompt_templates.prompt: Use my existing Pub/Sub subscription projects/p/subscriptions/my-sub and explain the watch flow.

prompt_templates.title: Export Filtered Messages
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up a Gmail watch for INBOX and UNREAD, use metadata format, poll every ten seconds, and write messages to ./emails.

output_examples.input: Watch my Gmail inbox once for unread messages.
output_examples.output: A one-time Gmail watch plan that uses the unread label filter and explains the expected streamed message events.

output_examples.input: Set up continuous Gmail watching for a project.
output_examples.output: Guidance that identifies the Google Cloud project, Pub/Sub resources, label filters, cleanup choice, and stream behavior.

output_examples.input: Export watched messages to local files.
output_examples.output: A safety note about sensitive email content, plus the selected output directory and cleanup approach.

best_practices: Use least-privilege Google credentials for Gmail and Pub/Sub.
Prefer metadata format unless full message bodies are required.
Use cleanup when temporary Pub/Sub resources are no longer needed.
anti_patterns: Do not stream full or raw emails into logs without a retention policy.
Do not write message exports to shared directories without access controls.
Do not leave unused Pub/Sub resources running after experiments.

faq.question: What does this skill watch?
faq.answer: It watches Gmail for new messages and streams events through the gws gmail +watch workflow.

faq.question: Does it send email?
faq.answer: No. It is focused on watching and reading new message events, not composing or sending mail.

faq.question: Can I filter by labels?
faq.answer: Yes. Use Gmail label IDs such as INBOX or UNREAD to limit watched messages.

faq.question: Does it need Google Cloud Pub/Sub?
faq.answer: Yes. Gmail push notifications use Pub/Sub topics or subscriptions.

faq.question: What happens after seven days?
faq.answer: The Gmail watch expires and must be renewed by running the watch setup again.

faq.question: Can it save messages to files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can write each message to a chosen output directory when configured.
